pins.name: SDA
pins.notes: Needs a pull-up to 3.3 V (about 4.7 kΩ)

pins.name: SCL
pins.notes: Needs a pull-up to 3.3 V (about 4.7 kΩ). Tie SCL to GND at power-up to use the one-wire mode instead

sources.title: Aosong AM2320 datasheet
sources.section: Pin 1 VDD, 2 SDA, 3 GND, 4 SCL; supply 3.1 to 5.5 V

sources.title: Aosong AM2320 datasheet
sources.section: I2C address 0xB8 (8-bit) = 0x5C; sleeps between reads and must be woken first, so a plain scan can miss it
